_meta.purpose: Frozen, fully-sourced input vector for a one-off, non-governing MSFT shadow FCFF DCF evidence proof. Every numeric field below carries its own source. This file is read by shadow_dcf.py AND independent_oracle.py so both engines value the exact same input vector.
_meta.notBasedOn: lib/analyzer/modules/scenarioOutputs.ts (production DCF) was not read, run or reused as a source for any number here.

revenueUsd.note: FY2026 331,839M matches the A1 derived-Q4 corrected TTM figure from PR #426's commit message; NOT the pre-fix naive-sum TTM.

capexUsd.note: FY2026 capex is a real, large step-up (FY2025->FY2026 +79.6%) consistent with Microsoft's disclosed AI/datacenter buildout; this is a genuine current driver of near-term FCFF compression, not a data error.

equityMethodInvestmentsUsd.treatment: non-operating asset, added back in equity bridge

equitySecuritiesNoReadilyDeterminableFvU.treatment: non-operating asset, added back in equity bridge

financeLeaseLiabilityUsd.note: Unusually large vs. long-term debt; consistent with real, disclosed sale-leaseback-financed AI/datacenter capacity additions. Treated as debt-equivalent per Damodaran convention.

sharesOutstandingCoverPage.note: 10-K cover-page count, 23 days after FYE; used over the balance-sheet CommonStockSharesOutstanding (7,427M at 2026-06-30) as the more current count. Mismatch vs. the historical price date (2026-09-04) below is ~6 weeks; share count drift over that window is immaterial and not separately adjusted.

realDataFromCommittedPriceCapture.source: lib/analyzer/acquisition/captures/prices.json (recorded 2026-09-08, provider YAHOO, used offline-mode only in the app)

historicalClose.label: HISTORICAL — explicitly not treated as a live/current price

externallySourcedAssumptions_mustBeReadA.note: Everything in this block was fetched via WebSearch (no live filing/spreadsheet fetch was possible in this execution environment: pages.stern.nyu.edu and www.sec.gov both failed DNS/CONNECT resolution through the sandboxed network proxy, 2026-10-14 — a tested, not assumed, network limitation). Each field states what it is and its uncertainty band; the report treats every one of these as a test-only, disputable scenario input, not policy.

effectiveTaxRateFy2026.source: Microsoft FY2026 10-K Note 11 text, quoted via WebSearch snippet: 'Our effective tax rate for fiscal years 2026 and 2025 was 19% and 18%, respectively.'
effectiveTaxRateFy2026.crossCheck: 32,185M provision / 165,934M implied pretax income (133,749M net income / (1-0.19)) = 19.4%, consistent.

riskFreeRate.source: 10yr UST ~4.79% (2026-09-02 snapshot) and ~4.66% (Fed H.15 weekly, week of 2026-07-24); no exact 2026-10-14 reading was retrievable in this environment. Point estimate 4.6% is a rounded mid-point of the two most recent real readings found, NOT a live quote.

equityRiskPremium.source: Damodaran implied ERP: 4.23% (Jan 2026 update), 4.20% (July 2026 update, post Moody's US downgrade adjustment).

beta.source: GuruFocus 1.1097 (Jun 26 2026), Google Finance ~1.13 (Jul 2026), Infront Analytics 1-yr 0.87 (undated, likely stale). Point estimate 1.00 is a judgment call rounding toward the middle of a wide, source-dependent range — flagged as a disputable assumption, sensitivity-tested.

pretaxCostOfDebt.method: Damodaran synthetic-rating approach: EBIT/cash-interest-paid coverage = 155,237M / ~1,500M (10-K 'cash paid for interest' for FY2026, from WebSearch snippet) ~= 103x, mapping to a top-tier (AAA-like) synthetic spread of ~0.4-0.5pp over the risk-free rate.
pretaxCostOfDebt.crossCheck: GuruFocus third-party 'effective interest rate on debt' = 5.90% (Jun 2026) is in the same ballpark and used only as a sanity check, not as the primary method (its exact computation methodology is not disclosed).

terminalGrowthRate.source: Set below the risk-free-rate point estimate (4.6%), consistent with the Damodaran stable-growth constraint g <= risk-free rate.

stableTerminalRoic.source: Judgment call: comfortably above terminal WACC (~8.6%) reflecting a durable (but moderating from today's unsustainably high) competitive-advantage return; flagged as the single most consequential unsupported/debatable assumption, sensitivity-tested.
